title: Beautiful views, comfortable boat
text: A great cruise with plenty of drinks and snacks available! We even had live music on board. A great way to escape the city heat and get a short tour of the beautiful harbor.
author: HG_Hook

title: Barcelona and the sea
text: Good attention from the staff, the experience is highly recommended, we enjoyed a good atmosphere, bar, and music for 1.5 hours of sailing
author: Montserrat_P

title: First experience
text: Very good experience with friendly crew and I recommend
author: s_bastienr179

title: You must do this!
text: Fabulous trip, great crew & 2 fantastic musicians who entertained throughout the trip. Excellent value for money.
author: Sarah C

title: Wonderful! A core memory of our trip!
text: So much fun! Live music, lovely day, drinks were reasonable, and a friendly crew on a spacious boat. Amazing tour of the waterfront and the perfect amount of time.
author: Harrison_R

title: A really lovely experience
text: A lovely experience which is reasonably priced. The journey lasted 90 minutes and the staff on board were very nice. I would definitely recommend.
author: Heena_R

title: A Mindblowing Experience
text: It was an amazing and breathtaking experience, the absolute highlight of our trip to Barcelona. Special thanks to Erik for giving us his power bank when our phones ran out of juice. Seriously, if you're in Barcelona, you cannot afford to miss out. The boat was lively throughout the whole 90-minute ride.
author: akubaf2025

title: Unforgettable Experience!!
text: My family really enjoyed this sailing experience. The atmosphere was wonderful with very friendly staff and wonderful live music. This was such a unique experience for us. The kids loved enjoying a “fancy” drink while sailing. Also a huge plus to have bathrooms on board. The price was very reasonable as well. Highly recommend this experience!
author: Melissa_C

title: Fun and relaxing view of...
text: Fun and relaxing view of the beachfront in Barcelona. Drinks are inexpensive and plenty of room on the boat
author: Matt_D

title: Would recommend
text: 100% recommended, great and fun experience all around. Good length, good music, reasonably priced refreshments and friendly service and staff.
author: richardreid2018
